blocks.h2: Plumbing Maintenance Questions From Hinsdale Homeowners

items.q: How often should we have a plumbing checkup?
items.answer: Once a year is a good rhythm, especially for homes with tankless heaters or several pumps.

items.q: Can a checkup help before buying an older home?
items.answer: Yes. Paired with a [sewer camera inspection](/hinsdale/video-camera-sewer-inspections), it gives you a clear picture before you close.

items.q: Is maintenance part of the No Drip Club?
items.preview: Yes, the club includes maintenance visits.
items.answer: The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club) includes regular maintenance visits. Ask us how it works.

items.q: What do you find most often in Hinsdale homes?
items.preview: Aging pumps, scale and old shutoffs.
items.answer: Aging sump and ejector pumps, scale in water heaters and tankless units, and shutoff valves that won't close.

items.q: We travel in the winter. What should we check before we leave?
items.preview: Shutoffs, the sump pump and pipes on outside walls.
items.answer: Know where the main shutoff is, test the sump pump and backup, and make sure pipes along exterior walls are protected. Some homeowners shut the main valve while away.

items.q: Do you inspect larger homes with several water heaters?
items.answer: Yes. We check every heater, pump and fixture group in the home.
Yes. We test the pump, timer and check valves on hot water recirculation systems.
